name: Santa Clara County Surplus Property Donation Program
description: Free County surplus property for eligible nonprofits and public agencies in Santa Clara County
fullDescription: The County of Santa Clara Procurement Department donates County surplus property at no cost to public agencies in the County and private nonprofits working for public benefit in the County.
whatTheyOffer:
- County surplus goods such as office furniture, seating, and supplies (availability varies)
- Items provided free of charge
- When several organizations request the same items, recipients are chosen by random selection and quantities may be limited
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a public agency in the County, or a private nonprofit currently working for public benefit in the County
2. Write a letter on agency letterhead, signed by the approving authority, identifying your organization as a nonprofit and describing how the property will be used
3. Mail it to Director of Procurement, Procurement Department, 2310 North First Street, Suite 201, San Jose, CA 95131-1040
4. Wait for notification and arrange pickup of allocated items
keywords: Santa Clara County, surplus property, nonprofit donation, free furniture, office equipment, technology, 501c3, county surplus
